text:
lina: Hey folks — PR #43121 is ready for cross-team eyes. Small routing tweak + KMS header flag. Plan: canary merge tomorrow 09:00 PT, promote at 10:00 PT if no regressions. Can @raj (runtime), @kevin (infra), @ashley (security) take a look? I left a short rollout plan in the PR.
raj: I can review runtime changes today. quick q: do we keep the existing KV cache TTL or bump for the new routing path? might affect tail latencies.
lina: keeping TTL at 60s by default, but added an override on the route config that operators can flip. snippet in the PR:
```yaml
routes:
  - name: llm-prefetch
    kv_cache_ttl: ${KV_TTL_OVERRIDE:-60}
    routing: fast-path
```
kevin: infra note — CI shows one failing test on ubuntu-20 matrix: "integration::startup_timeout". log extract:
```
ERROR: startup timed out after 120s
cmd: ./orch --pool-size=8
```
I re-ran and it passed on ubuntu-22, but we should be cautious for canary nodes that still run the older image.
ashley: security quick review: KMS header change looks fine but we need a one-paragraph threat-model note in the PR about header injection and KMS key scoping. also add a test that rejects malformed headers. I can draft the note if you want.
lina: thanks. please add that note, @ashley. i'll add the test case for malformed headers by EOD.
maria: i can own the merge window and monitor the canary. ping me 15m before 09:00 PT and i'll be at my desk.
raj: runtime comment posted — small nit on the async prefetch backoff logic, but not blocking for canary. i left an inline suggestion on the fallback path.
kevin: i'll watch infra metrics during canary (mem, p99 latencies). if ubuntu-20 nodes are in the canary pool i'll spin a temporary node with the newer base image and route traffic away from suspected hosts.
ashley: posted the threat-model paragraph in the PR and a single-unit test repro for malformed header. not blocking but required before full promotion.
lina: perfect. updated PR with ashley's note and added the test. CI is green on the matrix after a rerun. runtime, infra, security LGTM? if yes i'll queue for the 09:00 PT canary slot.
raj: LGTM from runtime side :+1:
kevin: LGTM from infra. i'll be online at 08:45 PT to help rollback if needed.
ashley: LGTM from security after my note. one small docs follow-up but not blocking.
runtime-oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled canary deployment for PR #43121 at 2025-06-08T16:00:00Z (09:00 PT). Ops channel: #deployments. Tagging oncall: @maria.
lina: thanks everyone — queuing the merge. i'll post links to canary dashboards when we flip it on.
